description: EduSpark is a team of young innovators passionate about science, technology, education, and solving real-world challenges. We believe in turning creative ideas into meaningful digital solutions. Our project, FACT ADDA Digital Space Lab, aims to make space science accessible through interactive astronaut training, mission simulations, educational games, and real-world space data. We welcome curious minds who love innovation, teamwork, research, coding, and building something impactful.
summary: FACT ADDA Digital Space Lab is a bilingual interactive space science platform featuring NASA and ISRO missions, a 3D Solar System explorer, NASA live API-powered space content, Earth science learning modules, and a 200-question daily quiz. It makes space exploration accessible through engaging digital education in Hindi and English.
